title: Frag
wikitext:
To [[frag]] is to "kill" another [[QuakeWorld]] player and in turn score a point (a frag). Not to be confused with ones actual kill statistic, players lose frags upon suicides, teamkills or environmental deaths.  This word is a shortening of "fragment", which is what happens during overkill as enemies are fragmented and explode into pieces, also known as gibs.
